_comment: A Masterpiece suppresses the three pairwise results among its members. There is no 'Masterpiece card' — these only emerge from holding three specific Instructions at once.

masterpieces.name: The Critic
masterpieces.effect: Seeking forks, each strips one part from whoever it hits. The anti-snowball nuke.

masterpieces.name: Final Draft
masterpieces.effect: One shot per magazine. Hitscan, infinite range, marks on kill, enormous damage.

masterpieces.name: Flood
masterpieces.effect: Paint an area that drains ink from every enemy in it into your pocket.

masterpieces.name: Scribble Storm
masterpieces.effect: The room fills with bouncing forking nonsense for 3 seconds.

masterpieces.name: Sandwich Board
masterpieces.effect: Heavy armour; everyone who shoots you is marked for your team.

masterpieces.name: Eraser Shavings
masterpieces.effect: Bouncing erase blobs that chew holes in the level. Map vandalism as a playstyle.

masterpieces.name: Debt Collector
masterpieces.effect: Marked enemies leak ink to you continuously; your shots find them anywhere.

masterpieces.name: Masterpiece
masterpieces.effect: Nobody knows. Rerolls its behaviour every 5 seconds. Named sarcastically. Reachable entirely through bad photocopies.

masterpieces.name: Human Shield
masterpieces.effect: You gain armour proportional to how badly you are currently missing.

masterpieces.name: Bulldozer
masterpieces.effect: Walk forward through everything. Shots punch a hole and the blast widens it.
